scope: Portable Ed25519-signed task handoff proposal bound to A1 sender machine identity, A2 authority-manifest evidence, and opaque recipient/executor identity-context digests. No delegation grant or execution authority is created.
core_invariant: A signed handoff proves which operational identity signed an exact task proposal under an exact authority snapshot. It does not prove the recipient or intended executor is trusted or authorized, and cannot substitute for live policy, revocation, approval, grant, lifecycle-consumption, or effect-admission checks.

risks: sign with a key not bound to A1 identity
pair handoff with a different credential
pair handoff with a different A2 passport
same recipient name rebound to another identity context
same executor name rebound to another runtime identity
opaque target digest mistaken for independently verified identity
controls: target digests are signed commitments only and do not create trust or authority

risks: purpose or destination outside principal ceiling
controls: resource ceilings bounded by A2 budgets and action timeout

risks: tampered execution_authorized or authority_effect field normalized away before signature/digest checks
controls: validate supplied semantic fields before normalization

risks: old signed handoff used after policy change
recipient assumes signature means current permission
reuse task input under different transport
controls: nonce and idempotency key are signed
future effect path must bind one-time lifecycle consumption and durable replay prevention

risks: MCP/A2A/vendor adapter treats handoff as permission

known_nonclaims: The handoff is not a bearer token, grant, approval, capability token, delegation record, or execution admission.
Cross-agent delivery does not grant the recipient authority.
Recipient/executor identity-context digests are signed target commitments, not independent proof those identities are trusted, current, or authorized.
The handoff does not prove global identity/revocation currentness.
The handoff does not consume one-time authority or prevent replay by itself.
The handoff does not create a remote executor or transport endpoint.
The handoff does not modify capability-registry state or a supported effect path.
next_gates: A3b reviewed authority-bearing delegation source before a non-null delegation-chain head is accepted
A6 live ancestor identity/delegation revocation and currentness at effect admission
A5 portable work receipt binding this exact handoff digest to executor/effect evidence
A10 independent verifier and cross-protocol parity tests
